summary.text: Athena Hollins is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 66B who has served since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She faces Republican Mary O'Neal in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Athena Hollins was born in Hilo, Hawaii.

She earned a bachelor's degree from Reed College in 2005 and a J.D. from the University of St. Thomas School of Law in 2011, and her career experience includes working as senior director of diversity and foundations.
Hollins defeated incumbent John Lesch in the August 2020 Democratic primary for District 66B and Mikki Murray in the November 2020 general election, taking office on January 5, 2021.

In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy, Public Safety and Criminal Justice Reform Finance and Policy, and Rules and Legislative Administration committees, serving as co-vice chair of the last.
